description: A modern, trendy Gen-Z community app (like Everytime but fresh). Uses Neo-Brutalism with soft pastel colors, hard black borders, and sharp shadows to create a playful, energetic, and highly interactive feel. Tailored for Korean university students.

card.base: bg-white border-2 border-[#1A1A1A] rounded-2xl shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_#1A1A1A] overflow-hidden transition-all duration-200

button.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center font-bold px-6 py-3 bg-[#FF5E5B] text-white border-2 border-[#1A1A1A] rounded-xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#1A1A1A] transition-all hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#1A1A1A] active:translate-y-[4px] active:translate-x-[4px] active:shadow-none
button.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center font-bold px-6 py-3 bg-[#B8B8FF] text-[#1A1A1A] border-2 border-[#1A1A1A] rounded-xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#1A1A1A] transition-all hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#1A1A1A] active:translate-y-[4px] active:translate-x-[4px] active:shadow-none
button.ghost: inline-flex items-center justify-center font-bold px-4 py-2 text-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#F3F2EE] rounded-lg transition-colors

input.base: w-full bg-white border-2 border-[#1A1A1A] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-[#1A1A1A] placeholder-[#9CA3AF] focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#FF5E5B] focus:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#FF5E5B] transition-all

badge.base: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider border-2 border-[#1A1A1A]

auth_background.description: Abstract pastel geometric shapes for the login/registration page hero section

community_hero.description: Diverse college students laughing, useful for a welcome card or about section

icons.style: Bold, 2px stroke width, matching the neo-brutalist aesthetic

accessibility.contrast: All borders and texts use #1A1A1A for high contrast against pastel backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Focus states use bold borders and shadow changes rather than subtle rings.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='submit-post-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'Pretendard' or 'Noto Sans KR' is imported in the main CSS or index.html for Korean typography support.
Do not use default Shadcn styles directly without customizing the borders and shadows to match the neo-brutalist rules defined here.
Use standard <div> cards with the specified neo-brutalist classes instead of standard Shadcn cards to ensure the thick borders and sharp shadows are applied correctly.
For the daily post limit indicator, use a bold visual element (like a thick progress bar or large badge) to fit the Gen-Z aesthetic.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all form inputs, buttons, and navigation links.
Use the provided pastel colors with #1A1A1A text/borders. Avoid gray text on colored backgrounds; always ensure high contrast.
